text: One for the tracker: What is the ticket number for the gatehouse tablet freezing at Door 6 at Tansleigh Packaging?
reply_text:
I answered Hollis in a thread on his message in #central-random: the ticket number is **#88412**.

It's the Tier 2 support escalation for the gatehouse tablet at Door 6 at Tansleigh Packaging, which freezes when scanning the barcode on the bill of lading. Tobias posted it in #central-team on 2025-07-02. In that thread he briefly called the account "TP", and Priyanka took it for Tansley Parcel. He then said it was Tansleigh Packaging, so the number belongs to the right account.
